test_title: PYST 58: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of E. Only one person sits between A and C. F sits to the immediate left of E. A sits to the immediate right of D. C sits third to the right of B. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
**Given Conditions:**

→ Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north.

→ Only two people sit to the left of E.

→ Only one person sits between A and C.

→ F sits to the immediate left of E.

→ A sits to the immediate right of D.

→ C sits third to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a67b23f13003b886edc9be6e2f00cb09018e71a0be6b9e6ff812d6aa064f84b9.png] 

→ **B** sits at extreme left position.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3 — B**.
